verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents bank and credit card reconciliation against the bank statement, and AI Close uses agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions and surface discrepancies. None of the evidence describes how matched, unmatched or duplicate transactions are categorized or presented for review. Missing for 10: explicit matched/unmatched transaction views, duplicate-transaction detection, per-account reconciliation workflow detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can reconcile each bank account against the ledger with matched, unmatched, and duplicate transactions surfaced for review

citations.quote: performing a reconciliation is the best way to ensure every single transaction is accounted for and matches your bank statement exactly
AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.
